GSE133601.preprocessing: already log2 RMA normalized by depositors with Brainarray hugene10sthsentrezgcdf v16.0.0
GSE133601.raw_CEL_role: optional technical sensitivity only; not required for the primary validation because the deposited matrix explicitly documents the exact frozen CDF and RMA procedure

GSE49800.preprocessing: deterministic log2(value) because deposited positive RMA values are on a linear/exponentiated scale
GSE49800.feature_identifier: GPL6244 Gene ID; exclude probes mapping to zero or multiple Entrez genes; aggregate multiple probes per Entrez by median after log2 transformation

sample_policy.primary_pairs: all 15 and all 18 complete manifest pairs
sample_policy.technical_outliers: flag only in primary analysis; no automatic sample removal after outcome inspection

protein_statistics.effect: mean participant-level delta expression, post minus pre
protein_statistics.primary_statistic: limma-style empirical-Bayes moderated paired t using the same variance-prior implementation as discovery
protein_statistics.multiple_testing: BH-FDR within each cohort and mapped-feature universe

reversal_orientation.discovery_direction: sign of frozen GSE75097 OSA-control beta
reversal_orientation.positive_interpretation: change opposite to discovery OSA direction
reversal_orientation.node_reversal_score: midrank percentile of oriented_moderated_t among measurable primary candidate proteins in the cohort

pair_endpoint.eligibility: both nodes measurable in the cohort; never rerank after missingness
pair_endpoint.primary_effect: mean pair_reversal_support in frozen top 1% divided by mean support in all eligible frozen pairs
pair_endpoint.binary_secondary: ratio of both-node reversal fraction in frozen top 1% to all eligible pairs
pair_endpoint.AUEC: trapezoidal area of cumulative support enrichment difference over frozen rank fractions 0.005 through 0.05

permutation.primary_node_aware: permute complete node reversal evidence vectors within deterministic blocks of 10 nearest nodes matched on frozen detection fraction and log2 protein length; recompute pair support on the unchanged pair graph
permutation.subject_aware: random within-subject sign flips of paired delta vectors followed by refitting node and pair reversal evidence
permutation.pair_graph_rewiring: not needed for the complete 250-node graph primary universe because every node degree is exactly 249; node-label permutation preserves node reuse and degree exactly
permutation.P_value: (1 + number of permuted statistics at least as large as observed) / (iterations + 1)

meta_analysis.primary_pooling: fixed-effect combination of cohort log enrichment ratios using permutation-estimated variance
meta_analysis.direction_discordance: if cohort enrichment directions disagree, report heterogeneity and do not claim pooled replication

negative_controls: bottom 1% of the frozen primary ranking
random ranking under the node-aware null
OSA context shuffled among matched nodes
same-direction CPAP change rather than reversal
model order-gap and truncation strata reported without filtering the primary result

multiplicity.primary_confirmatory_family: two cohort-specific top-1-percent enrichment tests plus prespecified meta-analysis
multiplicity.secondary_family: AUEC, binary reversal, baselines, weight sensitivities and stability strata
multiplicity.adjustment: BH-FDR within each reported secondary test family

prohibited: changing ranking weights, top fractions, endpoint orientation or permutation after viewing CPAP effects
merging GSE133601 and GSE49800 expression matrices
using validation results for model training, calibration or threshold selection
